headline: Querétaro proposes mixed projects to supply energy to industry
summary: Querétaro's state energy agency proposes mixed projects combining renewables, natural gas and storage systems to supply industry. The proposal is at the planning stage.
why: Querétaro is an industrial state in central Mexico with a large manufacturing base. Reliable power supply is a key factor for factory investment there.
original_headline: Querétaro plantea proyectos mixtos para suministrar energía a la industria
